## Grove Collaborative - Senior Software Engineer – Front End / Full Stack

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior front-end/full-stack engineer building scalable ecommerce experiences for Grove Collaborative, a sustainability-focused household and personal care company. Leading product initiatives across modern web and third-party commerce systems.
Senior front-end/full-stack engineer building ecommerce experiences for Grove Collaborative
- Salary: $180,000 - $215,000 per year
- Tech stack: GraphQL, JavaScript, React, Svelte, TypeScript, Vue.js

- Make architecture decisions, sequence work, and manage project tradeoffs
- Partner with product managers and designers on customer experiences

- Integrate with mobile apps, subscription services, analytics, search and discovery, and loyalty systems
- Use AI tooling to accelerate development while maintaining quality and independent judgment

- Collaborate with analytics partners to establish measurement and tracking

- Product and design thinking

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior front-end/full-stack engineer building scalable ecommerce experiences for Grove Collaborative, a sustainability-focused household and personal care company. Leading product initiatives across modern web and third-party commerce systems.
Senior front-end/full-stack engineer building ecommerce experiences for Grove Collaborative
Role description:
• Lead front-end and full-stack initiatives from ambiguous problem statements to shipped, measured outcomes
• Make architecture decisions, sequence work, and manage project tradeoffs
• Partner with product managers and designers on customer experiences
• Own performance, stability, accessibility, and maintainability of shipped code
• Integrate with mobile apps, subscription services, analytics, search and discovery, and loyalty systems
• Use AI tooling to accelerate development while maintaining quality and independent judgment
• Partner with UX Design to define and scale the design system and UI component library
• Collaborate with analytics partners to establish measurement and tracking
• Champion testing, documentation, and reusable team workflows
• Participate in take-home and working review interview process covering system design, coding, product thinking, and AI usage
Role requirements:
• 7+ years building and operating production web applications, with the front end as your strongest area
• Deep expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript
• Experience with at least one modern component framework (React, Vue, Svelte, or similar)
• Experience with state management and performance optimization for consumer-facing applications
• Comfortable working across APIs, data models, integrations, CI, the browser, and infrastructure
• Ability to become productive quickly in unfamiliar frameworks, languages, or platforms
• Experience leading projects from vague problem statements through shipment
• Product and design thinking
• Strong written and verbal communication of technical tradeoffs
• Genuine enthusiasm for Grove’s mission and sustainability values
• Experience with Shopify, ecommerce at scale, subscription commerce, GraphQL, testing tools, Git workflows, CI, accessibility, A/B testing, and experimentation platforms are advantageous
• Must be based in California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, or Massachusetts
Benefits:
• Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental
• Equity - shared success is core to our mission
• Flexible Paid Time Off
• Free VIP membership and 50% employee discount
• Annual incentive target
Tech stack:
GraphQL, JavaScript, React, Svelte, TypeScript, Vue.js
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
